name: Screenity 4.6.5
body:
- Fixed an issue with encoding which could cause it to record in lower quality.
- Fixed audio sometimes slowly drifting ahead of the video in long recordings.
- When recording with the cloud platform, the editor can now use the local data from the extension directly instead of waiting for the remote file.
- Fixed custom region recordings on scaled displays being saved with the wrong dimensions.
- Improved mic audio quality on recordings without system audio, where a mono mic was duplicated across two channels which halved effective bitrate.
- Made the extension load faster on first install, and on new tabs, making pages feel more responsive.
- Fixed an issue where enabling the camera from the popup didn't automatically select the default camera device.

name: Screenity 4.6.4
body:
- Fixed a few frames being dropped mid-recording whenever the encoder briefly fell behind, which could show up as a small stutter on playback. 
- Recordings no longer lose frames in the first moments while the hardware encoder is still coming up to speed, which mostly affects slower machines.
- Resuming a paused recording no longer loses frames while the encoder restarts.

name: Screenity 4.6.3
body: - Fixed a race between the frame reader and the static-screen fallback that could swallow every incoming frame

name: Screenity 4.6.1
body:
- Fixed recordings failing to start on some Windows machines due to a hardware encoder problem.
- Fixed recordings automatically stopping a few seconds after starting on slower machines, from a watchdog false positive.
- Fixed the "Can't load your recording" message appearing over recordings that were actually fine, including after cancelling the screen picker.

name: Screenity 4.6.0
body:
- Capture now happens at 2× the encode size and is downscaled for greater detail.
- MediaRecorder recordings are now MP4/H.264 instead of WebM/VP9 by default.
- Added a warning on sites that block camera/mic through Permissions-Policy (like facebook.com).
- Custom area recording is now disabled up front on sites that block it.
- System audio warning toasts now appear at the bottom, so they aren't hidden behind Chrome's screen-share picker. 
- Fixed an issue where region recordings silently fall back to VP8 and lose the first ~3 seconds.
- When the hardware encoder is unavailable or busy, recording now retries using the software encoder instead of failing.
- Recording now recovers faster after the computer wakes from sleep.
- Cropped recordings now retain their original format instead of being converted to WebM and incorrectly labelled.
- Fixed incorrect bitrate reported dimension calculations on ultrawide displays.

name: Screenity 4.5.6
body:
- You can switch which tab you're recording again, using Chrome's "Share this tab instead" button (only on tab recordings made on "Screen" mode).
- Fixed switching to a tab with a different aspect ratio stretching the rest of the video. It now letterboxes to keep the correct proportions.

name: Screenity 4.5.5
body:
- Fixed the camera preview not showing before recording, where the bubble would sit there loading until the recording started.
- Fixed short recordings sometimes being wrongly flagged as corrupt.
- Fixed a single capture hiccup permanently pushing all your later recordings onto the slower encoder.
- Fixed a second recording on the same tab occasionally being routed to the previous, already finished session.
- Opening the color and brush menu while drawing no longer steals keyboard focus or scrolls the page.

name: Screenity 4.5.4
body:
- Fixed region recordings sometimes getting stuck when starting, which required restarting the browser to clear.
- Fixed Chrome's screen picker opening behind the "your microphone is muted" confirmation on region recordings.
- Fixed region recordings occasionally starting before you clicked Start.
- Removed the "audio is silent" warning that could appear mid-recording when you simply weren't speaking.
- The display no longer goes to sleep during a recording, which could freeze the video while the audio kept running. This uses a new "power" permission, held only while you're recording.

name: Screenity 4.5.3
body:
- Fixed "can't load your recording" errors on big files that timed out while loading.
- You can now cancel a download that's taking too long, like a slow WebM conversion, instead of being stuck waiting.
- Saving as WebM now handles large recordings without running out of memory
- More reliable recording starts, especially when Chrome restarts the extension in the background, with automatic retries on transient failures.
- Recordings that captured content but got interrupted while stopping are now recovered and saved instead of discarded.
- Fewer false recording failures on backgrounded or static screens.

name: Screenity 4.5.2
body:
- Recordings are more resilient when Chrome restarts the extension's background worker mid-session.
- Fixed an issue with Chrome's own "Stop sharing", that sometimes threw an error.
- Fixed recordings failing to start on slower devices, where acquiring the capture stream could take a few seconds.
- More reliable recording when another app (Teams, Zoom, etc.) takes over the hardware video encoder.
- The editor opens quicker, as soon as the recording is finalized.

name: Screenity 4.5.1
body:
- Fixed macOS recordings sometimes failing on completely static screens.
- Fixed WebCodecs recording falling back to MediaRecorder after harmless static-screen stalls.
- Fixed screen/window recordings sometimes failing to start in the background recorder on Windows.

name: Screenity 4.5.0
body:
- Recordings now run in the background using the offscreen API instead of a pinned tab, so they keep going even if the tab you started from gets frozen or discarded.
- The editor is lighter and faster now that it runs entirely on WebCodecs, with the ffmpeg fallback removed.

name: Screenity 4.4.14
body:
- Screen and window recordings on macOS can now capture system audio (on macOS 14.2+ with Chrome 141+)
- Recordings now recover from silent encoder stalls mid‑recording by rebuilding the encoder instead of cutting the recording short
- Fixed a brief freeze when opening the editor after a recording, by moving recording duration repair off the main thread
- The audio warning shown before recording now matches what actually gets captured on your platform

name: Screenity 4.4.12
body:
- Fixed silent audio in cloud recordings on some Chromium browsers without AAC encoder support, by falling back to WebM with VP9 and Opus
- Recordings stay smooth when the recorder tab is in the background, with stronger signals to prevent Chrome from throttling the recording
- Fixed a duplicate editor tab occasionally opening after stopping a recording, when Chrome's storage was under heavy contention
- Fixed the "Can't load your recording" modal briefly appearing during a successful editor load

name: Screenity 4.4.11
body:
- Fixed a Windows recording issue where some hardware encoders could silently produce no output.
- Improved the Windows hardware encoder checks to avoid a crash during startup probing.
- Fixed a case where Screenity could get stuck thinking it was “Already recording” after a recording session had ended.
- Fixed a back-to-back retry issue where starting a new recording immediately after a failed one could sometimes fail to start
- Improved macOS audio recovery when the audio system is interrupted, for example after an audio server restart, a phone call, or another app taking exclusive audio.
- Added a warning when Bluetooth microphones switch into low-quality headset mode, which can drop mic quality to 24kHz or lower.
- Improved mic-change detection during recording, including cases where a removed microphone still appears to be live.
- Added cleanup for old upload recovery data so Chrome’s local storage does not slowly fill up over time.

name: Screenity 4.4.10
body:
- Faster editor open after stopping, especially when many tabs are open
- Cloud recording uploads recover from temporary network and auth hiccups instead of restarting from scratch
- Fixed the microphone briefly turning on when toggled off, which was causing unnecessary permission prompts and iPhone Continuity Mic disconnects
- Fixed a quick cancel occasionally putting recordings on a slower encoding path

name: Screenity 4.4.9
body:
- Fixed the extension staying logged out after signing back in on the app, it now picks up the new session automatically
- Fixed the editor occasionally failing to load the last recording, especially on slower disks where the file was still being flushed when the editor opened
- Fixed the stop button briefly going clickable again while the recording was still finishing, which could trigger a phantom restart

name: Screenity 4.4.8
body:
- Recordings start faster, especially cloud recordings. Uploaders, encoder warm-up, and Bunny setup now run in parallel instead of in sequence
- WebCodecs encoders reclaimed mid-recording (long pauses, background-tab throttling, HW contention with Teams/Zoom/NVIDIA) now rebuild silently instead of breaking the recording
- Fixed recordings stalling on a static screen on macOS
- Drawings made during the countdown now persist into the recording instead of getting cleared on the transition
- Smoother stop flow for multi-scene recordings, with the toast and popup no longer competing for attention

name: Screenity 4.4.7
body:
- Fixed back-to-back recordings interfering with each other
- Cleaned up leftover recorder tabs that could linger after a recording ended or a previous session was interrupted
- Fixed the editor showing a "stuck" error on long recordings that were still loading
- A screen, tab, or region recording is no longer cancelled when the camera is unavailable (used by another app, or permission denied), it now continues without the camera
- Fixed cloud recordings failing to start when the upload couldn't be created due to a temporary network or server hiccup, it's now retried automatically
- Fixed the Pro onboarding tips Driver.js popup not displaying correctly

name: Screenity 4.4.5
body:
- Fixed scenes occasionally failing to save when starting a new recording right after stopping the previous one
- Resolved the “Cannot capture a tab with an active stream” error when re-recording the same tab too quickly
- Stopped the popup from getting stuck on “Starting recording...” after a failed start or extension restart
- Improved Bluetooth and USB headphones handling so connected devices record properly on the first attempt

name: Screenity 4.4.4
body:
- Recordings on Linux Chrome now also use the fast WebCodecs path (VP9 + Opus + WebM) instead of the slower MediaRecorder + ffmpeg conversion
- Fixed long MediaRecorder recordings (over 7 minutes) sometimes opening the wrong editor view
- Fixed the "Download as MP4" and "Download as WebM" buttons sometimes ignoring clicks

name: Screenity 4.4.3
body: - Fixed audio cutting out mid-recording on Windows when the system audio source goes silent

name: Screenity 4.4.2
body:
- Recordings that completed but didn't open after stop are now routed to the correct editor view based on OPFS or IndexedDB storage
- Faster recovery for interrupted recordings
- Fixed issue where setup.html could close mid-recording if starting from the setup page
- Better troubleshooting

name: Screenity 4.4.1
body: - WebCodecs encoder failures mid-recording now automatically swap to MediaRecorder

name: Screenity 4.4.0
body:
- WebCodecs is now used for cloud recordings too, with faster encoding and smaller files
- Recordings now write chunks directly to disk via OPFS instead of IndexedDB during the session, with much lower memory use and more reliable long sessions
- Chrome extension auto-updates are now held until you're done recording or uploading, so updates can no longer interrupt an active session
- Added clearer feedback for silent recordings, camera disconnections, failed restarts, and oversized GIF or audio exports
- More resilient recording starts and recovery, including navigating away during the countdown, slower Windows cold-starts, and storage-write failures
- Fixed tab recordings showing black bars when the recorded tab was narrower than the capture frame, and the first second of recordings sometimes showing stale frames after the countdown
- Improved Pro upload reliability with better recovery from interrupted uploads

name: Screenity 4.3.8
body:
- Fixed recordings getting stuck when stopped via Chrome's own "Stop sharing" button
- Fixed seeking issues on certain MP4 files in external players like QuickTime
- Resolved issue on tab recordings where toolbar could disappear on navigation

name: Screenity 4.3.7
body:
- Webcodecs is now the default (when available) for local recordings, for faster exports and better reliability
- Fixed issues where longer webcodecs recordings could fail to load or edit in the editor
- The MP4 download is now always available for webcodecs recordings, regardless of length
- Increased the editing time limit to 15 minutes for webcodecs recordings
- Improved recording reliability during long sessions, with better recovery from stalls and interrupted chunks
- Fixed an issue where the modal for requesting permissions would keep showing persistently

name: Screenity 4.3.6
body:
- Cloud uploads now retry automatically in the background when interrupted, and handle network or sign-in issues more gracefully
- Improved recording stability during longer recordings, with more resilience against Chrome freezing or discarding the recording tab
- Fixed styling issues that could affect elements on the page
- Improved troubleshooting reports with more information to investigate issues

name: Screenity 4.3.5
body:
- Improved tab recording startup to reduce Chrome throttling issues, with clearer recorder states like “Preparing…” while the recording is getting ready
- Fixed multi-scene recording state issues, including cases where multi-mode could be lost after cancelling a countdown or discarding a scene
- Improved multi-scene flow with a loading state between scenes and fixes for cases where finishing could fail silently
- Disabled drawing, blur, and cursor tools during camera-only recordings since they don’t apply
- Fixed the system audio setting being reset after extension updates

name: Screenity 4.3.4
body:
- Fixed cases where the recorded page could become non-interactive for a few seconds after recording starts
- Fixed recording sometimes failing to start after cancelling a previous countdown
- Added a "Preparing recording..." state before countdown so it's clear when the recording is getting ready
- Added configurable FPS settings in the 3-dot menu in the popup, for local recordings
- Improved camera background blur and effects with a faster, more accurate model
- Improved internal diagnostics for Pro users to make recording issues easier to investigate
